decisions.reason: The firm has invested in a dedicated page and nearly 200 agency templates, and customer praise for its agency focus supports keeping this GDPR-related tool, which fits the firm's agency-oriented direction.

The platform has been featured on the home page in both years, so it is the most visible commitment and central to the firm's announced hosting direction, and dropping it would contradict its public positioning.

The configurable managed hosting plan has had its own page for two years and is close to the firm's core hosting business, so sunk investment and strategic fit favor keeping it even if results are modest.

Extended PHP support is a recent add-on that is only mentioned on the website, so commitment is lower, but it is cheap to keep alongside hosting and any weak uptake can still be put down to its recent launch.
